DCF fair value is estimated at $14.37 vs the current price of $12.18, representing a margin of safety of 18.0%. Quantitative technicals indicate an intact primary uptrend with price above the 200-day moving average ($11.08). Systematic 3-tier accumulation is recommended at $11.94 (Tranche 1), $11.21 (Tranche 2), and $10.35 (Tranche 3).
